annotation.justification: The target clause provides a clear and specific requirement for servers generating a 206 (Partial Content) response. It explicitly lists the header fields that MUST be included if they would have been sent in a 200 (OK) response to the same request. There is no language that permits multiple materially different interpretations, and all terms used are well-defined in the context of HTTP/1.1 and this draft. The clause does not introduce ambiguity.
